newsitem.title: USA: First Republic Bancorp CEO Muscal quits.
newsitem.headline: First Republic Bancorp CEO Muscal quits.

text.p: First Republic Bancorp said Friday that Zvi Muscal had resigned as president and chief executive officer, and as chairman and co-chief executive officer of its subsidiary, First Republic Bank, effective immediately.
The company said Muscal will continue his relationship with the bank, serving as a consultant.
Muscal co-founded ExecuFirst Bancorp in 1987 and served for eight years as president and chief executive officer of its sole subsidiary, First Executive Bank.
The institution became known as First Republic Bank last June, upon completion of its merger with Republic Bancorp.
